car.name: Firethorn Turbo 2005
car.description: Original logo-free 2994 brick-red and teal four-door turbo sedan. US 2005 standard T850 five-speed manual inspiration, not ACR or Commemorative. Estimated OEM mass and inconsistent published overall gearing are disclosed.

catalogProvenance.inspiration: US 2005 Dodge SRT-4 standard four-door sedan, T850 5MT FWD LHD, not ACR or Commemorative Edition

sources.kind: Direct OEM Chrysler PDF, personally visually inspected all four specification pages
fields: Engine output and electronic limit, T850 ratios, Quaife LSD, estimated curb mass, dimensions, tires and steering

estimates: 2900 lb is explicitly estimated OEM curb mass, not exact measured production mass. Fuel and driver convention unspecified; no additional driver or fuel added.

Published individual gear factors .76 times 3.53 yield 2.6828, NOT printed overall top gear 3.2. Retain OEM rounded physical factors without rescaling; fourth .97 differs from secondary .947 and is not tooth-count verified.

6240 electronically limited engine speed is sourced; 6000 redline display and 800 idle are estimates. Curve outside 2200–4400 plateau, .8bar boost, CG .52m, overhang split, 26USmpg, 150mph/5.7sec display, normalized suspension/brake/shift/clutch/launch and 32psi setup are simulation estimates.

Standard Quaife limited-slip existence verified; front lock .35/.1 are gameplay approximations, NOT measured Quaife calibration. No ACR or Commemorative parts. Suspicious block-material claim is not encoded.

205/50R17 nominal geometric radius .3184m used consistently by setup and runtime; differs from .311979m calculated from published 821 revolutions/mile. OEM 17x6 wheel width conflicts with secondary6.5; no unsupported width substitution.
